name: Skepta Rap Dance AI
tagline: Skepta Rap Dance AI puts your trio into the viral Skepta dance
description: Skepta Rap Dance is a TikTok group-dance trend where three dancers step, lift their knees and turn in sync. Skepta Rap Dance AI makes it yours: upload three clear, front-facing waist-up solo photos and assign each to the left, center or right dancer. Pick one of four scenes (the original parking garage, a city rooftop, a night street or a dance studio) and the same three-person choreography is generated with your friends. Track progress in My videos, then download a 1080p MP4 with sound for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts. Confirmed failed generations return credits. Available in multiple languages.
